title: Japanese Tourists Are the Most Polite — Survey
paragraphs: The United Nations says that, in the first three months of 2026, 307 million people left their home countries to travel. That's up 2% from the year before, or 6 million more people.
The number of tourists going to Europe went up by 4% — and so did the number going to Africa. The number going to Asia and the Pacific went up by 3%.
With so many people traveling the world, we might want to ask: Which tourists are the most polite?
That's a question Africa-based SafariBookings.com asked 192 of its tour operators.
And the largest number of its tour operators — 21% — said Japanese tourists were the politest.
Next were Norwegians, named the politest by 11% of tour operators. Then came tourists from Switzerland, Canada and the US.
SafariBookings.com also asked a few other questions.
When asked which tourists were the best tippers, 30% of tour operators said it was Americans. Just 13% said Germans were the best tippers, and Canadians came next at 10%.
Americans, Germans and Canadians were also named the biggest spenders.
But 21% of tour operators said Germans were the most "adventurous" tourists. Eighteen percent said French tourists were the most adventurous, and 11% said it was tourists from the Netherlands.
And Asian tourists won for food — with tourists from India, Japan and China named the biggest "foodies." They were even bigger foodies than tourists from France and Italy!
